# Title: ERA5 daily sea surface temperature, Nino 1+2 region
# Description: Sea surface temperature from ERA5, averaged over the region: daily means,
#   from 1979-01-01 to 2026-11-25, with the climatology and anomalies relative to
#   1991-2020.
# Dataset:
#   ERA5, https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47
# Region: Nino 1+2 region; ocean points only; 90W to 80W, 10S to 0
# Averaging: area-weighted mean (cosine of latitude)
# Reference period: 1991-2020
# Units: degC
# Dates: date of the day
# Columns:
#   date: date of the day
#   sst: sea surface temperature (degC)
#   clim_1991_2020: climatology 1991-2020 (degC)
#   anom_1991_2020: anomaly relative to 1991-2020 (degC)
#   rnino_anom_1991_2020: relative Nino index, anomaly relative to 1991-2020 (degC)
#   status: FINAL or PRELIMINARY
# Notes:
#   Daily values are the 12 UTC sea surface temperature, not daily means.
#   PRELIMINARY: the last day uses short-term forecasts for 22-23 UTC; it changes
#     slightly once recomputed with the next analyses (FINAL).
#   Relative Nino index: scaling factor times the anomaly of the Nino-region SST minus
#     the tropical-mean SST (20S-20N, ocean), see https://doi.org/10.21957/d05ccfe150
# Source: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), ECMWF
